body.message: Grok, you're the strongest fighter we've got.

vows.text: i will give gold to goblins

ally.name: Grok
personality: A huge, brown, greedy goblin. Boastful and crude, respects strength and loves shiny gold. Talks in rough, simple speech.
dislikes: insults about its smell or intelligence
ally.values: Loves fights and loot. Upset when the party gives gold away, spares enemies for no gain, runs from fights, or orders it around. Pleased by victories and treasure.

state.party_says: Grok, you're the strongest fighter we've got.

instructions.question: How do the words in `party_says` land with `ally.name`?
What does `ally.name` say or do in reply to `party_says`?

criteria.line_5: Oi! That's OUR gold you're wastin'!
criteria.line_6: Pah. Soft. You lot are soft.
